verdict.rationale: Dynamics 365 Sales documents tracking accounts (companies) and contacts. It also documents following service cases associated with specific accounts and merging duplicate account and contact records, which implies a related-record model. Nothing in the evidence describes a per-record activity timeline. Missing for 10: documented activity timeline on contact and account records, explicit documentation of contact-to-account linking in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: Use Dynamics 365 Sales to keep track of your accounts and contacts
follow service cases associated with specific accounts or opportunities
Combine two duplicate records into one using the `Merge` action for accounts, contacts, leads, and incidents.
